description: Edit Review of a cut before upload (25 credits; an unlisted or public YouTube link up to 60 minutes): cuts a minute, long shots, dead air, sound changes, on-screen text, and the notes as Premiere CSV, Resolve EDL and FCPXML markers. Runs as a job. Same as POST /v1/review/edit; to review the file itself (when YouTube refuses our servers the link is refused free with upload_instead), send it to POST /v1/review/edit/upload.
